title: The Frequency home announces the beta (free through January 1) and every feature CTA on it leads to the one beta entry at /join

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14: We're in beta until January 1, let's announce that and do clear calls to action into our beta sign up. Analyze the home page and design in a couple announcements with appropriate CTAs on the page. Each feature CTA leads to the same beta intake flow. Owner addition the same day: one copy pass that subtly ties in the name (a rhythm, the vibe, people on your wavelength) while keeping the near-you search phrases.

detail: Under SITE_DESIGN frequency the home had no word of the beta and its CTAs fanned out to /the-community, /spaces, /pricing and a dozen /features anchors. Now the hero carries a side-coloured pill (Free while in beta, through January 1, linking to /join) and one primary for both sides, Join the beta, beside the See how it works anchor; a night band after the story (Frequency is in beta. Help us build it.) states free until January 1, founding members and a say in what gets built, with $0 and 3-steps figures and a Join the beta button; the closer's two buttons became one Join the beta with the date line under it; the dock gained a Join the beta button (the switch drops Community below 560px so it fits a phone). All 24 chapter Acts links, both path doors (now links, so HomeMotion's door scroll went) and the Live this week host button go to SITE.join (BETA_CTA_HREF, /join). Browse this week and the #weave anchors stay navigation. No beta-end constant exists in lib (BETA_PRICING_ENDS_AT is the closed 2026-08-17 pricing window), so the date is one BETA_UNTIL constant in the home body. DAWN is untouched; the page reads no request data. A copy pass in the same change ties in the name without puns: the fold's third line (the rhythm that keeps them coming back), both path doors (people on your wavelength; set the rhythm), the Come back chapter (same time, week after week), the Circle feature card (same time each week), the beta band (founding members set the rhythm) and the closer (same feeling when the room is right). The h1, lede, headings and near-you phrases are unchanged.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const b=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/site/pages/home/frequency-home.tsx','utf8');const c=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/site-pages-a.css','utf8');const bad=[];if(!b.includes('className=\"beta-pill\"'))bad.push('no beta pill in the hero');if(!b.includes('id=\"beta\"'))bad.push('no beta band');if(!b.includes(\"BETA_UNTIL = 'January 1'\"))bad.push('no January 1 end date');if(!b.includes(\"BETA_CTA = 'Join the beta'\"))bad.push('no Join the beta CTA');const acts=b.match(/[{] href: [^,]+, icon:/g)||[];if(acts.length<24||acts.some(a=>!a.includes('SITE.join')))bad.push('a chapter Acts link skips /join');if(/className=\"pd [lr]\" data-set/.test(b)||!/<Link className=\"pd l\" href=[{]SITE.join[}]/.test(b))bad.push('path doors do not lead to /join');if(!/<div className=\"dock\">[\s\S]*href=[{]SITE.join[}]/.test(b))bad.push('dock has no beta button');if(/href=[{]SITE.(people|spaces)[}]>/.test(b))bad.push('a feature CTA still points past /join');if(!b.includes('the rhythm that keeps them')||!b.includes('Founding members set the rhythm here'))bad.push('no rhythm copy pass');if(!c.includes('.pa-home .bb{'))bad.push('beta band unstyled');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-885: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
